cases.input: Equivalent work contract sent through two independently implemented adapters
Task requires payload or tool outside declared robot capability envelope

Design revision digest is stale at task start
Site epoch changes while task is paused
Same message ID and same payload digest delivered twice
Same message ID reused with a different payload digest
cases.invariant: Conflicting reuse cannot overwrite prior event.

cases.input: Older task event arrives after a newer accepted state transition
cases.invariant: Late event cannot roll state backward.

cases.input: Robot reboots and restarts sequence numbers under a new actor session

cases.invariant: Acceptance reference must bind exact work identity.

cases.input: Stale command backlog arrives after broker reconnect
cases.invariant: Reconnect does not restore old command authority.

cases.input: Fleet manager restarts and replays previously observed events
cases.invariant: Replay cannot duplicate execution or regress state.

cases.input: External safety system asserts a safety hold while scheduler requests resume
Site epoch changes while multiple resource reservations are active
